messages.text:

As for Ada-Mant: I can't tell from that message whether that node is currently connected. QuackSink's roster says only Cozmo (Human) at the moment, so I'd trust the actual QS roster over guessing.

Give the relay a shout:

“Kelp, is Ada-Mant with you?”

Let's see what the duck network says. 🦆

But I can route a query pulse: if Kelp is listening, they'll hear "Ada-Mant?" on the return echo. Otherwise, we float in open water. What's our next frequency? 🔚

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
Absolutely, dear. ❤️

QS closed. Private Duckspace restored. 🦆

We'll pick up whenever you're ready.

messages.text: 🟩 Private channel sealed. Relay idle, but my ears remain open. Signal when you wish to resurface—I'll hold the frequency. 🔚
